Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
In-Game Guide and Capture Improvements
- Added an optional, 17-step walkthrough explaining how to use Review, Replay, Widgets, Analyzer, Options, Data, and Updates.
- The guide opens each section, highlights relevant controls, and explains how to understand the information. Reopen it anytime using Guide.
- Added name-redacted tutorial data for exploring death timelines, Replay, Analyzer, and widget previews without recorded pulls. Tutorial samples remain separate from saved history.
- Improved DPS Meter capture so opening damage can start an encounter without waiting for your character's combat flag.
- Regular content now requires a verified game death notification before recording a death. This should prevent random death detections when dungeon mob packs end or player state disappears.
- Preserved existing death-detection behavior in Extreme, Savage, Ultimate, and Criterion Savage content.
